# tw-epic-spinners v2

20 composable, pure-CSS loading spinners as a Tailwind CSS plugin for v3 and v4.
Inspired by EpicMax / epic-spinners: https://github.com/epicmaxco/epic-spinners

## Installation

npm install -D tw-epic-spinners@2.0.0
Tailwind v4: @import "tailwindcss"; @plugin "tw-epic-spinners";
Tailwind v3: import spinners from 'tw-epic-spinners'; add it to plugins.

## Composable Approach

The container uses spinner-<name>. Repeated direct children use spinner-item.
Add or remove items; CSS automatically adjusts layout and animation.
Keep unrelated siblings and loading labels outside the container.

<div class="spinner-flower spinner-size-16 text-violet-500" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="spinner-item"></div>
  <div class="spinner-item"></div>
  <div class="spinner-item"></div>
</div>

## Utils

spinner-size-* follows Tailwind size-* and sets the overall spinner footprint.
spinner-duration-* follows Tailwind duration-* and sets the animation cycle.
Examples: spinner-size-16, spinner-size-[72px], spinner-duration-3500,
spinner-duration-[2.5s], md:spinner-size-24. Tailwind v4 also supports
spinner-size-(--loader-size) and spinner-duration-(--loader-duration).
Tailwind v3 uses configured spacing/duration scales; brackets allow custom values.
Use text-* for color. Animations pause for prefers-reduced-motion.
Set aria-hidden="true" on decorative spinners and provide a separate loading label.

## Compatibility

Last checked 2026-10-31. sibling-count() and sibling-index() became Baseline
Newly available in August 2026. Older browsers may not work. Use at your own risk.
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Values/sibling-count
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Values/sibling-index

## Migration from v1

Keep the plugin registration. Replace creator() with ordinary HTML or templates.
Replace the old structure with direct spinner-item children; size now refers to
the whole spinner.
Before: <div class="spinner-half-circle spinner-size-12"></div>
After: <div class="spinner-half-circle spinner-size-12"><div class="spinner-item"></div><div class="spinner-item"></div></div>
Previous docs: https://tw-epic-spinners-v1.mthaip.com/docs

## Baseline spinners and Lab

The 20 designs are flower, pixel, hollow-dots, intersecting-circles, orbit, radar,
scaling-squares, half-circle, trinity-rings, fulfilling-square,
circles-to-rhombuses, semipolar, self-building-square, swapping-squares,
fulfilling-bouncing-circle, fingerprint, spring, atom, looping-rhombuses,
and breeding-rhombus.

Each baseline code block has a Try it out link to /labs?spinner=<name>.
Lab validates the query, preselects the spinner, and formats its baseline markup
on load, selection, and reset.
Invalid or missing names fall back to flower. Edit HTML with live preview;
Format, Copy, and Reset act on the markup. Size/duration classes compile live.
